title: Google Course list
statusNote: Active (the surviving 'course' page; English only, all regions). Needs markup for at least three courses.
notes: Not checked: a summary page needs an ItemList with itemListElement ListItems that each have a unique canonical position and url.
Course: description (display limit 60 characters) and name required; provider (Organization) recommended.

Summary or all-in-one pages must add ItemList: required itemListElement (ListItem) with position and url (each unique, canonical). itemListElement.* belongs to the ItemList node on the list page, not the Course.
